summary: This change makes network requests more reliable by giving the client more time to complete and retry logic to smooth over transient failures, improving the overall user experience.

items.title: Requests are given more time to complete
items.after: timeout_seconds is 5, giving the client more generous headroom per request.
items.statement: The timeout value increases to give each request more generous headroom before it is considered failed, improving reliability under load.

items.title: Networking module context
items.statement: This client module handles a variety of networking concerns including connection pooling, retries, and timeouts in a robust, production-grade way that the team has iterated on for a long time.
